note: Hand-written inputs of national_banks.py (2026-11-19): bank and currency NAMES per polity, the nominal unit scale of each currency (how many local units a 1 Cr of 3126 buys at PPP parity; a cultural choice like the yen's 100 vs the euro's 1), the regime -> institutional quality table, and the shared rules (fees, grace, lifeline). Every RATE and EXCHANGE RATE is DERIVED by national_banks.py from economy_3126.json (growth, GDP per head, population) and these qualities. Cr = the Sol Authority credit, the network's reserve and settlement unit (all world_economy prices are in Cr).

anchors.sources: Real-world anchors: neutral real rate r* ~0.5 % (Holston-Laubach-Williams 2023); inflation targets 2 % (Fed / ECB / BoE); emerging-market policy rates 6-12 %; major-currency daily FX volatility 0.4-0.6 %, emerging ~1 %; PPP real-exchange-rate half-life 3-5 years (Rogoff 1996) - a managed float reverts faster (2 y here); Balassa-Samuelson price-level elasticity to income ~0.3; retail overdraft ~8-10 % above base (EU), card FX fee 1-3 %, SEPA-like intra-bloc transfers ~free, SWIFT cross-border 0.5-1 % / fixed fee.

no_bank.gj832_gaia_zone: Зона «Филоморфоз»: нет государства (режим none_quiet) - нет банка; на её хабах платят солнечным кредитом, спасательный кредит выдаёт банк Тяньхэ (держатель карантинного кордона).

rules.garnish_protected_note: TRADE_DESIGN §1.3 / §11 item 6: a garnish of income never takes the free money below this. A round trip of a Cobrett-I: 2 legs of reactor fuel (2 x 2 454 Cr, TRADE_DESIGN §5.3) + 2 dockings (2 x 384 Cr, a bureaucratic port) + one day of berth (cap 400 Cr) = 6 076 -> 6 100 Cr. Real analogue: the German Pfändungsfreigrenze / the UK protected earnings rate.
rules.tow_note: 2 in-system legs of a service tender (reactor fuel 4 650 Cr / leg, FUEL.md) x 1.5 crew and wear; maritime analogue: SOLAS rescue duty (free) + commercial towage at cost. Tow is never refused (beyond the lifeline limit it is billed as an interest-free lifeline debt).
rules.min_repair_note: ~2 % of the Cobrett hull structure (520 000 Cr, ship_economics components_cr): a patch to airworthiness, not a full repair.

player_start.note: ~5 months of a pilot's wage (4 000 Cr / month, ship_economics anchors) saved, an arranged overdraft of one month's wage.

prices.fuel_free_note: Author 2026-11-19: fuel costs 0 for the player and the AI for now. The model still computes the list price; the switch only zeroes what is charged.

jump_charge.source: real LWR fuel cost split (WNA 2023): uranium 41 %, conversion 5 %, enrichment 36 %, fabrication 18 % - the closest real analogue of a refined isotope charge

reactor_fuel.source: D from water (Girdler-sulfide / electrolysis, energy-heavy) + He-3 from gas-giant mining (extraction dominates); pellet fabrication
